metadata.title: Spectroscopic Signatures of Extra-Tidal Stars Around the Globular Clusters NGC 6656 (M22), NGC 3201 and NGC 1851 from RAVE

notes: No eligible stars. The paper’s “unbound” and extra-tidal language concerns stars beyond a globular cluster’s tidal radius, not unboundness from the Milky Way: it defines an extra-tidal star as “an unbound star when it exceeds the tidal radius” (T:p3-b1) and later describes such stars as “unbound and are therefore not part of the cluster’s tidal radius” (T:p6-b11). The tabulated RAVE extra-tidal candidates (T:p6-b5, T:p6-b6, T:p7-b5) remain candidate cluster debris/members and are not identified as Galactic unbound candidates; the final assessment calls them “promising extra-tidal candidates” (T:p9-b3). Proposed extra-galactic origins or tidal-debris associations alone do not establish Galactic-unbound candidacy.
